prompt:

Keep its actual projection, anatomical ownership and two leg chains. The SECOND image contains cropped appearance/material samples ONLY: use its detailed painterly polished steel/gold, oxblood cloth, brown leather and swept dark hair style to finish the knight. Do not infer a frontal pose from the material crops.

His head crown is AHEAD of and BELOW the pelvis/belt in image space as in the3D guide; it overlaps/hides the chest. Do not put a frontal head above a long visible breastplate. See the CROWN of his unhelmeted dark hair, TOP surfaces of shoulders and shortened top-down torso. No visible eyes, no face looking up, no frontal chest pointing at the camera. Upper body remains upright with a slight natural forward running lean, not a man lying flat.

CRITICAL TWO LEGS: there are exactly TWO legs and TWO boots. AnatomicalRIGHT contact leg is imageLEFT and reaches forward to the lower-left boot. AnatomicalLEFT recovering leg is imageRIGHT and trails behind to the upper-right boot. The boots at those two guide locations are the ONLY boots. Do not leave an obsolete extra boot under the belt. Resolve hip-to-knee-to-calf attachment and natural occlusion completely in this one unified drawing.

The kite shield hangs UPRIGHT, so from this vertical camera only its narrow curved top rim/back sliver is visible; its front red/gold chevron face is naturally hidden. Match the thin projected shield in the guide, do not lay a broad frontal kite flat toward the camera. It is the same normal-sized shield foreshortened in depth, not a smaller shield. Gloves and grips stay attached.

Lucan's identity: young adult human male knight, bare head with swept dark brown hair; articulated polished silver steel with restrained gold edging, oxblood split tabard, pale chest motif mostly hidden by overhead occlusion, dark trousers, brown boots/gloves. Preserve natural full body proportions and actual limb length; the footprint shortens only because of view projection. Cool moonlight and restrained existing warm rim accents, no palette flash. True TRANSPARENT background, no floor/shadow, no diagram colors or primitive cylinders, no labels/grid/text, no extra limbs/equipment. Keep complete hair, both boots, sword point and shield within generous clear margins.
